related_questions.question: Should I have the spring COVID booster?
related_questions.snippet: If you are eligible and you have missed an earlier booster, you should have a dose this spring to catch up. Most people do not need extra doses to make up for those you have missed. If you have a severely weakened immune system your doctor may advise an extra dose 3 months after you have the spring vaccine.
